mapper.sql: r.id, r.record_no, r.department_id, r.profession_id, r.location, r.inspector, r.responsible_unit, r.responsible_person, r.problem_description, r.problem_image_urls, r.rectification_deadline, r.rectification_effect, r.rectification_image_urls, r.rectification_time, r.reviewer_id, r.review_effect, r.review_image_urls, r.review_time, r.nature_definition, r.assessment_situation, r.safety_score, r.status, r.create_time, r.update_time, r.deleted
mapper.select: SELECT , r.group_leader_name as group_leader_name, r.deputy_leader_name as deputy_leader_name, r.inspector as inspector_name, d.dept_name as department_name, p.dict_value as professionName, u5.real_name as reviewer_name FROM sys_inspection_record r LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON r.department_id = d.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dictionary p ON r.profession_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u5 ON r.reviewer_id = u5.id AND u5.deleted = 0 WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = 0
